summary.zh: Tibo 回复“周二凌晨 3 点”。这可能是重置时间提示，但原文没有直接提到重置，也没有注明时区，因此尚未确认；若按美国太平洋夏令时推测，对应台北/北京时间周二 18:00。
summary.en: Tibo replied “3am on a Tuesday.” This may hint at reset timing, but the post does not explicitly mention a reset or specify a timezone. If interpreted as Pacific Daylight Time, it would be Tuesday 18:00 in Taipei/Beijing.

summary.zh: Tibo 引用此前的重置预告，确认这次重置已经完成发放。
summary.en: Tibo confirmed the rollout, quoting the earlier reset announcement.

posts.text: And of course, a reset is also landing by midnight today.

summary.zh: Tibo 在介绍质量改进时预告当日午夜前重置，随后发帖确认完成。原文这句没有注明时区。
summary.en: Alongside quality fixes, Tibo announced a reset by midnight. A later post confirmed completion. This sentence does not specify a timezone.

posts.text: Everyone who used one in the affected time window is getting another one and an email to apologize.

summary.zh: 部分用户使用备用重置时未能完整恢复额度，Tibo 宣布为受影响时段内的使用者补发一次，并邮件说明。
summary.en: Tibo announced replacement banked resets for users whose redemption had not fully restored usage during the affected period.

posts.text: All reset for everyone. Enjoy the week with Astra.

summary.zh: Tibo 确认面向所有人的重置已经完成。
summary.en: Tibo confirmed that the reset for everyone had completed.

posts.text: We have now reset usage for all paid subscriptions for ChatGPT Work and Codex.

summary.zh: Tibo 确认 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 的全部付费订阅已经重置用量。
summary.en: Tibo confirmed a usage reset for all paid ChatGPT Work and Codex subscriptions.
